title: How Do You Go to School?

paragraphs.en: How do you go to school? I go to school by bike.
paragraphs.cn: 你怎么去上学？我骑自行车上学。

paragraphs.en: My father goes to work by car. It is fast.
paragraphs.cn: 我爸爸开车上班。它很快。

paragraphs.en: My mother goes to work by bus. She takes the No. 5 bus.
paragraphs.cn: 我妈妈乘公共汽车上班。她乘坐5路公共汽车。

paragraphs.en: Sometimes I walk to the park with my friends. It is good exercise.
paragraphs.cn: 有时我和朋友们步行去公园。这是很好的锻炼。

paragraphs.en: We should follow the traffic rules and stay safe on the road.
paragraphs.cn: 我们应该遵守交通规则，在路上注意安全。
